_doc: Suzunari Gakuen inside (src/world/school.gd). floors: map files data/maps/school_<id>.txt. rooms: name plate at `door` (a wall tile), lights over `rect` [x0,z0,x1,z1]. features: interactables at `tile` with a scene (Town.scene: `name`, `open`, `choices` [{t, say, fx}]) or `variants` (first whose `when` matches; when = Amane.ok keys + `after`/`before` minutes + `chance`). fx adds `minutes` (time passes), `tears` (Amane), `bond`. people: Town spirits placed indoors (`indoor` floor + `itile` in data/town.json). doors: exterior tiles in Suzunari that lead in.

variants.open: Inside your indoor shoes: an envelope sealed with a sticker of a cat paw. The handwriting on it is very, very careful.

choices.say: 'Senpai. I counted. You smiled four times yesterday. Three were at me. (I think.) Please have a good day. - A.' There is a pressed sakura petal inside.

choices.t: Put it in your bag for later.
choices.say: You tuck it away. Somewhere behind the cubbies, someone exhales very quietly.
You close the locker on it. Behind you, a sniffle, then quick footsteps going upstairs.

variants.open: Your indoor shoes. And, on top of them, a folded note in handwriting you don't know: 'THE 13TH STEP. DUSK. DON'T COUNT OUT LOUD.'

choices.say: You keep it. On the back, in pencil: a little drawing of a ghost with a camera. Kuroe-senpai's style.
You drop it in the bin by the door. The bin is labelled BURNABLE. It looks like it agrees with you.

variants.open: Your indoor shoes, a little damp. A cat hair on the left one. White.

choices.say: Street shoes in, uwabaki on. The squeak of the floor says: you are a student here now.
It is very long and very white, and it smells faintly of rain.

features.name: Trophy case
features.open: Cups for track, kendo and a 1987 calligraphy prize. At the back, a faded class photo: Tanabata 2001, three students on the shrine steps.

choices.say: A boy with Makabe-sensei's glasses. A laughing girl with a bell on her phone strap. And a boy who looks exactly like your father, already looking away from the camera.
One character, brushed huge: 約 - 'promise'. The winner's name has been scratched off the plaque.

features.name: Entrance notice board
features.open: Club recruitment week! OCCULT RESEARCH: one member, seeking two. NEWSPAPER CLUB: we know what you did. GARDENING: please water the roof pots. LOST: a black umbrella. It is back on the stand every morning anyway.

choices.say: 'THE SUZUNARI SHIMBUN - Truth, rumours, and whichever sells.' Hayase Hina's phone number is printed in a heart.
Hand-drawn. A torii, a cat, a staircase going up into nothing. 'Club room: the old building. Bring salt.'
You leave the board alone. A first-year pins up a flyer: HAS ANYONE SEEN THE SHRINE BELL?

features.name: Makabe-sensei's desk
features.open: Neat stacks of essays, a red pen, a dead pot plant he refuses to throw away. The bottom drawer is locked. There is a key-shaped dust mark next to the pencil cup.

choices.say: Locked. Through the gap you can see envelopes, dozens, tied with string. Each one addressed in the same hand: 'Sayo'.
The top essay is yours. In the margin, in red: 'You write like someone who has said goodbye before. Good. Not too often.'
Staff rooms have rules. You keep them. Somewhere, a teacher nods without knowing why.

features.name: Attendance book, class 1-A
features.open: Nekomori Amane. Present, present, present. Every year, the same absence: July 7th. In the remarks column, in three different teachers' handwriting: 'Tanabata.'

choices.say: You close it. Some absences are not truancy. They are appointments.
Asagiri Toru, transferred this spring. Someone has drawn a tiny cat ear on the A in Asagiri. In pencil. Lightly.

features.name: Infirmary bed
features.open: Clean sheets, a curtain on a rail, the smell of disinfectant and dried lavender. The bed by the window is the one everyone fights over.

choices.say: You sleep. You dream of a long road at night and a dog walking beside you. You wake up feeling better, and someone has put a cold towel on your forehead.
You sit. Through the curtain, the clock ticks. Nobody asks you anything. It is the quietest place in town.
Pencil marks on the wall, years of them. One set has two little triangles drawn on top of each line. Ears.

features.name: Medicine cabinet
features.open: Plasters, antiseptic, eye drops, a jar labelled CATNIP (CONFISCATED), and a box of tissues that is always, somehow, almost empty.

choices.say: A plaster with little rabbits on it. It helps more than it should.

choices.t: Ask who uses all the tissues.
choices.say: From her desk, without looking up, Fujimura-sensei says: 'A first-year. Every day. Be nicer to him.'

features.prompt: Buy something at the school store
features.name: The school store

variants.open: A hand-written sign: YAKISOBA BREAD - SOLD OUT. (12:31. Every day. It is not a conspiracy.) There is still melon bread and milk.

choices.say: Crunchy on top, fluffy inside. The store lady slips you a sugar packet 'for the cat'.
Too sweet. Perfect.

choices.t: Ask why it always sells out at 12:31.
choices.say: 'Because at 12:30 a boy with a hood buys four, and runs. Every day. For somebody, I suppose.'

variants.open: Steam from the bread warmer, a queue of first-years, the store lady counting change faster than a till. Yakisoba bread: 150 yen. Melon bread: 130 yen.

choices.say: The legendary yakisoba bread. Still warm. Three students behind you sigh as one.
Crunchy on top, fluffy inside.
You buy two. When you turn around, he is already there, holding out both hands like a cat that heard a can open.

features.name: Counselor's room
features.open: Two soft sofas, a box of tissues, a sign: 'You can talk about anything here.' Nobody is in. A notebook on the table invites you to write anonymously.

choices.say: You write it. Under it, the next morning, in the counselor's tidy hand: 'Is it a person, or a cat? Both are allowed.'
You write it. Under it, in someone else's hand, small and shaky: 'me too.'
You sit. It is nice that a room like this exists.

features.name: Class 2-B, your desk
features.open: The back row by the window: the protagonist seat. Through the glass: the courtyard, the sakura, the long road down to the sea. Your desk has old carvings under the varnish.

choices.say: Makabe-sensei reads a love poem from the Manyoshu and then pretends he didn't. Time passes the way it only does in class.
Down in the courtyard a hooded first-year is sitting under the sakura, staring straight up at your window. He waves, panics, and hides behind the tree.
Under the varnish, initials from long ago: 'M.A. + S.N. 2001' and, much older, almost gone: a little cat and the words 'I will come back'.

features.prompt: Look at the desk with dog stickers
features.name: Class 2-A, Hayate's desk
features.open: Every inch covered in dog stickers. A half-eaten bento with your name on the lid. Of course.

choices.say: You take it. A note inside the lid: 'payment for walking you home. -H'
You write 'Thief.' He will frame it.

features.name: Library: local history
features.open: Rows of town history, yokai encyclopedias, cookbooks and a whole shelf of shoujo manga someone donated in 1998. The local history shelf is suspiciously well-worn.

choices.say: The 1703 tsunami, the 999 steps, the 1868 riots, the cat shrine. A chapter on the six Jizo thrown into the sea. A photo caption: 'the steps at dusk - please do not count them.'
Kappa, nopperabo, the okuri-inu, the nekomata. In the margin of the nekomata page, a child has written: 'not all of them are scary. some just wait.'
Hell, hungry ghosts, animals, fighting spirits, humans, heavens. 'A soul that waits faithfully can climb from one realm to the next.' Someone has underlined 'waits'.

choices.t: Check the borrowing card at the back.
choices.say: One name, once a year, every July, from 1961 to 2023: 'Asagiri G.' Your grandfather read this book every Tanabata for sixty years.

variants.open: 16:44. The light goes strange. In the mirror, you are standing on the shrine steps in a dark kimono, holding a bell out to a white cat. Then a man in an old uniform in a school corridor. Then a teacher at a harbour, arms around children.

choices.say: Your fingers touch cold glass. Every one of them looks back at you with the same apology.
You look away. When you look back it is just you, and a girl at the easels asking if you're okay.

variants.open: A tall old mirror, its frame carved with waves. The art club says not to look into it at 4:44. The art club says a lot of things.

choices.say: You look fine. Normal. Transparent. Exactly what you wanted. It feels worse than you expected.

choices.t: Ask the art club about it.
choices.say: 'It's made from pieces of an old mirror from the temple. At 4:44 you see who you used to be. Or so they say. Fufu.' Even the art club does the fufu now.

features.name: Art club easels
features.open: Watercolours of the town: the river, the station, the steps. One canvas is just rain, very carefully painted, in eleven shades of grey.

choices.say: 'A first-year from 1-A. He paints it every day. He says it's a self-portrait.'
One stroke of sky in all that grey. Tomorrow someone has painted a tiny sun next to it.

features.name: The Suzunari Shimbun
features.open: Front pages pinned in rows: 'CAT COUNT EXCEEDS STUDENT COUNT', 'FISHERMEN REPORT LIGHTS AT SEA', 'WHO RINGS THE BELL AT MIDNIGHT?' A corner is plastered with printouts of the Ura board.

choices.say: Anonymous posts, circled in red: 'the transfer student made a first-year cry AGAIN' and 'he looks like the photo in the trophy case'.
'CHILD FOUND SAFE ON SHRINE STEPS AFTER THREE DAYS.' The child's name is withheld. The photo shows a small boy holding a bell that isn't his.

features.name: Student council room
features.open: A long table, a gavel nobody uses, a whiteboard of rules. Rule 1: Keep your word. Rule 2: See rule 1. A silk scarf is folded on the president's chair. It is April.

choices.say: 'The cats are taking over the courtyard.' 'Please stop the first-year crying in the stairwell.' 'The transfer student is suspicious.' That last one is in very elegant handwriting.
It is cold, like it was left in snow. You put it back before you know why.

features.name: Storage room
features.open: Festival lanterns, a broken taiko drum, sports-day flags, a box marked TANABATA 2016 - DO NOT OPEN.

choices.say: Paper decorations, a child's yukata belt, and a wish strip in crayon: 'I want to go home with him. - Suzu'. Not 'Amane'. Suzu.
BOOM. Somewhere downstairs Makabe-sensei drops his coffee.

features.name: Class 1-A, Nekomori Amane's desk
features.open: Tidy. Too tidy. A pencil case shaped like a fish. In the desk, a notebook with a cat on the cover, and on top of everything, a carefully cut-out photo of the school roof.

choices.say: Pages of you. Your timetable. Your favourite bread. 'Senpai smiled 4x.' And on the last page, in older, rounder handwriting: 'Soichiro-sama, I am still waiting.'
You leave a melon bread on the desk. In the afternoon the rain over the school stops for exactly one hour.
You don't touch anything. It feels like the right kind of respect.

features.prompt: Look at the desk covered in charms
features.name: Class 3-A, Kuroe Mio's desk
features.open: Omamori charms tied to every hook, a pile of salt in the pencil tray, and a video camera with tape still in it.

choices.say: Grainy footage of the 2F corridor at dusk. It goes on and on. It shouldn't be that long. At the end, a bell rings and the tape stops.
You pocket some salt. You feel like it might be useful later.

features.name: Music room piano
features.open: An old grand piano, lid up. Sheet music on the stand: a lullaby with no title, copied by hand. The keys are warm, as if someone just stopped playing.

choices.say: Your hands know it. You don't. Halfway through, somewhere in the building, someone starts humming along - a woman's voice, old, gentle. Your aunt sings this song.
Chopsticks, badly. A cat on the windowsill outside looks personally offended.
You close it. The room feels like it's waiting for midnight.

variants.open: The anatomy model is not in its corner. There are footprints on the dusty floor, leading to the corridor, and a sound: running.

choices.say: You run. It runs. It is surprisingly fast for a man made of plastic. You win by a lung. It bows, and walks back to its stand.
Everyone needs exercise.

variants.open: Half skin, half organs, all plastic, with a sticker on its stand: PLEASE DO NOT TAKE ME RUNNING.

choices.say: Its hand is warm. You decide not to think about it.
Donated 1963. Name: 'Jinta-kun'. Below, a list of science club members who 'lost the race'.

features.name: Science lab shelf
features.open: Rock samples, a jar of sea water from 1945 labelled HARBOUR, a model of the solar system missing a planet, and a dish labelled KAPPA'S DISH (REPLICA).

choices.say: It is completely clear. The label says the water has never gone cloudy, not once in eighty years.
It is not a replica. It is still slightly wet.

variants.open: Lunch time. Amane is already here, sitting on the bench with two bentos, pretending he didn't know you'd come.

choices.say: He moves over so fast he nearly falls off the bench. The rain over the town thins to a mist.
'...One is for the cat.' There is no cat. The second bento has your name on it in seaweed.
He nods too many times. 'Okay! Okay.' He leaves both bentos on the bench when he goes.

variants.open: The whole of Suzunari below: the shrine on the hill, the station, the river, the sea. From up here the town looks like a model someone made very carefully.

choices.say: You shout. The wind takes it toward the shrine. A bell rings back, once. It isn't time for bells.

choices.t: Count the cats on the roofs.
choices.say: Eleven. Twelve. All of them facing the school. All of them facing you.
Sea wind, cherry blossom, chalk dust. For a moment you are not anybody's anything.

variants.open: Omagatoki. You count the steps going up. Ten, eleven, twelve... thirteen. There are only twelve steps. On the thirteenth, a bell rings, very close.

choices.say: You keep climbing and climbing, and then the stairwell is just the stairwell again. Your phone says three minutes have passed. It felt like an hour.
You step back. Twelve steps. Behind you, someone sighs with relief - or disappointment.

variants.open: Twelve steps, scuffed in the middle by eighty years of uwabaki. A sign: NO RUNNING. Someone has added: NO COUNTING AFTER SIX.

choices.say: Twelve. Of course twelve.
Wise. Some things in this school are better left uncounted.

eggs.yakisoba: You got the legendary yakisoba bread before 12:31.
eggs.mirror_444: At 4:44 the art room mirror showed every life you have lived.
eggs.lullaby: The piano remembered a lullaby your family has sung since 1868.
eggs.anatomy_race: You outran the anatomy model. Jinta-kun will want a rematch.
eggs.roof_shout: The shrine bell answered you from the hill.
eggs.thirteenth_step: You stood on the thirteenth of twelve steps.
